ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixel distribution with high-intensity (white) mottling covering approximately 20-25% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark pigmentation zones across lateral lobe fields. High-contrast white mottling concentrated around the median notch extending into the inner lobe regions. Distinct vertical white linear clusters present on the lower-center and right-lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 50-60 degree aperture angle relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing edge boundary with moderate-frequency serrations. Notable pixel-level jaggedness on the distal tips and mid-sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edge curve. Trailing edge follows a dual-concave sweep from the median notch to the outer points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of circular high-contrast white spots visible on the distal tips of both lobes and scattered across the central dark pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct vertical and diagonal white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the dark pigmentation, most prominent on the right lobe (viewer's right).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive vertical rake marks on the ventral surface and irregular scarring/depigmentation at the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, frayed appearance of the extreme outer corners of the fluke lobes.
